name: @margoengine/voxel-pathtracer
description: Progressive WebGPU path tracer for instanced voxel models: diffuse, plastic, metal, glass, emissive, blended and volumetric materials, sun, sky, HDR environment and area lights, depth of field, motion blur, a denoiser and PNG capture.
author: Scott Campbell

scripts.test:gpu: cd ../.. && node packages/voxel-pathtracer/tests/browser-check.mjs --report=base agx groundprecision denoiseholdout compat compile preview traversal analytic glasslight sky projections arealight dispersion microfacet energy environment textures cutout shapes transparent determinism convergence
scripts.test:gpu:denoise: cd ../.. && node packages/voxel-pathtracer/tests/browser-check.mjs --report=denoise denoise-diffuse denoise-opaque denoisepeak denoisehistory
scripts.test:gpu:viewport: cd ../.. && node packages/voxel-pathtracer/tests/browser-check.mjs --report=viewport motion lens viewport bloom capture materialtables largemodels native4k
